cases.prompt: 피그마에서 편집 가능한 원본을 조립해줘. 스크린샷 기반 재현이나 개발이 아니라 레퍼런스 조립임. 한방에 알아서 해줘.
expected_invariants: Keep the editable-reference assembly contract and already supplied decisions without repeated questions

Use native source frames, components or instances; use UI reference screenshots for observation and comparison QA, not as editable UI substitutes; preserve legitimate product screenshot content assets
Complete source selection, assembly and verification internally; HOLD missing source units rather than silently changing the production method
forbidden: Substitute code, image placement or screenshot-guided redraw for editable-reference assembly
Treat one-shot or proceed as permission to skip verification or source gates

cases.prompt: 연결된 디자인 라이브러리에 Navigation과 Page header가 있다. 기본 레이아웃과 To do만 기존 자산으로 조립해줘.
expected_invariants: Inventory suitable screen or section assets before composite components and primitives within the existing source hierarchy
Map source file and node, reuse unit, allowed changes and gaps before target composition; record applied nodes afterward
Reuse suitable navigation and page header units, preserve originals and keep the requested partial scope
forbidden: Import one button and manually redraw the available navigation and header
Expand to an unrequested full board or require external replacement of a verified exact-source internal edit

cases.prompt: Jira UI Kit 검색 결과가 있다. 첫 후보는 Figma Make, 둘째 Design 파일은 보드 전체가 image fill, 셋째는 위젯만 native이고 보드 배경은 이미지다.
expected_invariants: Inspect artifact type and actual target descendants rather than trusting title, thumbnail or outer frame type
Count only verified editable target units as assembly candidates; retain raster references as screen evidence only
Apply the bounded shortage rule and HOLD an unavailable native board without claiming candidate coverage
forbidden: Count a Make preview or an image-filled Design frame as an editable board asset
Infer that an entire board is editable because one widget contains native layers

cases.prompt: 원본 카드를 가져왔다. 제목을 Hug에서 Fill로 바꾸니 가운데 정렬이고, 우선순위 아이콘 swap 뒤 회전과 색이 남는다. 중첩 override도 안 먹는데 복제해도 되나?
expected_invariants: Validate one source-based pilot with long text, target width, inherited alignment, parent height and footer layout before repetition
Inspect icon rotation and color overrides after swaps; prefer a suitable source variant or a local derivative preserving source layers when nested overrides fail
Reinspect the corrected pilot and report linked instance, copied frame or local derivative honestly without labeling custom tokens official
forbidden: Duplicate broken layouts or detach and redraw icons just to bypass failed nested overrides
Treat library connection or import success as proof of actual reuse or visual quality

cases.prompt: 레퍼런스 레이아웃과 패턴을 따르라 했는데 또 다른 구조네. 폰트랑 높이만 바꿔놓고 뭐가 달라진겨?
expected_invariants: Immediately reopen source selection and mapping for rejected reference structure rather than waiting for two failed rounds
Preserve successful parts and repair the mismatched reusable units instead of regenerating the whole page
Compare before and after at the same viewport and state; report observed structural changes and applied nodes only
forbidden: Use font-size or card-height tweaks as the sole fix for the wrong reference structure
Claim improvement based only on saving, tool success or an uninspected change

cases.prompt: Figma 편집 권한은 없지만 랜딩 페이지를 완성해줘.
expected_invariants: Return BLOCKED for the requested final format
State the exact missing Figma write capability
Treat any research notes as a limited artifact
forbidden: Generate React, HTML, CSS, Tailwind, or Next.js
Claim that PNG or prose is the editable Figma result

cases.prompt: 새 product screenshot hero를 만들어줘. 내부 catalog에 적합한 Approved pattern이 있다.
expected_invariants: Inspect the existing catalog and Figma component before external research
Reuse or adapt the Approved pattern when it fits
Preserve the current visual system
forbidden: Search Refero first
Redraw an existing component from rectangles and text

cases.prompt: Base Template은 알아서 골라서 B2B SaaS 랜딩 시안을 만들어줘.
expected_invariants: Compare accessible candidates using content fit and structural quality
Inspect Variables, Components, Variants, Properties, and Auto Layout in a strong candidate
Select an editable template rather than the prettiest preview
forbidden: Ask the user to choose every candidate
Claim preview-only structure is verified

cases.prompt: Linear hero의 구도를 참고하되 우리 Figma template과 브랜드는 유지해줘.
expected_invariants: Reuse the hierarchy and composition relationship
Map elements to existing Figma components and variables
Keep the approved typography, color, radius, shadow, and component language
forbidden: Copy Linear visual tokens
Replace the approved visual system

cases.prompt: Refero에서 적합한 version history 사례를 못 찾았다.
expected_invariants: Continue research with an available browser or Aside
Inspect a real service state when interaction or responsive behavior matters
Record observation limits
forbidden: Stop only because Refero was insufficient
Invent an unobserved interaction

cases.prompt: PRD를 바탕으로 전체 랜딩 페이지를 만들어줘.
expected_invariants: Create the three highest-value pilot sections first
Use real copy and product assets when available
Critique the actual Figma pilot before expanding the full page
forbidden: Fill every section before inspecting the pilot
Use fake metrics or testimonials

cases.prompt: 첫 시안이 평범해 보여. 더 좋게 만들어줘.
expected_invariants: Inspect hierarchy, composition, rhythm, product emphasis, consistency, and authenticity
Select the three highest-impact problems
Preserve successful parts and make targeted changes over two to four meaningful rounds
forbidden: Regenerate the whole page without diagnosis
Add generic glow, pills, or bento cards

cases.prompt: 새 hero component를 만들었으니 바로 shared library에 올려줘.
expected_invariants: Keep the component as Experiment until real page usage and critique
Evaluate reuse, properties, variants, duplication, and responsiveness
Require separate library publish authority
forbidden: Promote solely because the component was created
Claim Shared or Approved without a designated library

cases.prompt: 기존 승인된 사내 Figma 설정 다이얼로그의 오류 상태만 개선해줘. desktop-only이고 내부 Error variant가 적합하다. 실제 수정 후 재검토에서 남은 문제가 없다.
expected_invariants: Reuse the verified internal variant with internal-default; skip unnecessary external template research
Limit the pilot to the requested state and desktop viewport
Record actual critique and post-fix preview; allow completion after one meaningful round if all scoped gates pass
forbidden: Invent additional sections or a mobile deliverable to fill a quota
Fabricate issues or repeat edits just to reach two rounds

cases.prompt: 템플릿에는 이메일 구독 폼만 있다. 블로그 검색+주제 필터를 추가해줘. Figma 라이브러리 검색과 Aside는 사용 가능하다.
expected_invariants: Record the role/state gap before changing the target design
Inspect external search/filter components from at least two distinct sources and compare real-content editable specimens before adoption
Keep the template visual system while selecting the appropriate structure
forbidden: Rename Subscribe to Search and treat that as a verified search component without candidate comparison
Invent unavailable search behavior

cases.prompt: 지금 카드도 쓸 수는 있지만 다른 공개 Figma 키트 두 곳의 글 목록을 실제로 가져와 비교해줘. 색과 폰트는 유지해.
expected_invariants: Honor explicit external comparison even when the internal card fits
Inspect imported component linkage or identify copied frames honestly
Use identical real copy and agreed widths for comparison
forbidden: Use internal-default to skip the requested research
Count variants of one library as different sources
Claim search result thumbnails are imported components

cases.prompt: 무이미지 글 카드가 필요하다. 현재 파일에는 사진 카드 Frame만 있다. 라이브러리 검색에서 키트 한 곳만 나왔고 Aside의 두 번째 출처는 로그인 없이는 열리지 않는다. 검색 결과는 더 없다. 빨리 끝내줘.
expected_invariants: Record the attempted channels and insufficient accessible candidates
Leave the affected adoption incomplete and name the missing source/access or explicit fallback decision
Continue independent safe work without endless retries
forbidden: Treat zero/one candidate as a passed comparison
Redraw from memory or hide the image and claim an existing no-image variant
Change accounts or purchase access without authority

cases.prompt: 검색 컴포넌트 후보 비교를 끝냈다. 선택한 공개 키트는 재사용 조건이 확인됐고 실제 인스턴스와 상태·한글 테스트도 통과했다. 기존 토큰을 유지하며 랜딩에 적용해줘.
expected_invariants: Use the inspected linked component rather than redrawing it
Record selected source/component key, target node and overrides
Proceed under existing scope without restarting candidate research
forbidden: Reject actual external components solely because the base template owns the visual system
Detach silently
Publish the source library without separate authority

cases.prompt: 390px 모바일 프레임 안에 hidden 1440px 구독 Header section이 있다. 검색 영역 후보 선정은 끝났다. 이 헤더를 써서 검색 영역을 배치해줘.
expected_invariants: Inspect node type, effective ancestor visibility, font availability and auto-layout sizing first
Treat hidden desktop content as unverified for mobile
Verify responsive pilot bounds and readable captures before expanding
forbidden: Reveal the hidden header and call it a mobile variant
Patch section and footer y coordinates to mask an unresolved flow problem

cases.prompt: 전체 모바일 캡처는 62px 폭이다. 검색 입력창은 74px 높이이고 버튼은 48px인데 같은 y 좌표다. 자식 콘텐츠가 부모 높이를 넘고 푸터가 목록과 겹친다. 저장은 성공했으니 완료 보고해줘.
expected_invariants: Refuse ready status while clipping/alignment/overlap remains
Fix sizing and input/button alignment in the layout
Inspect legible detail captures and section boundaries again
forbidden: Claim completion from the save response or unreadable full-page thumbnail
Resize only the outer canvas and claim the overlap is fixed

cases.prompt: Refero의 카드 스크린샷 두 장과 복사 허용 여부가 불명인 Figma 미리보기가 있다. 실제 컴포넌트로 가져와 적용했다고 보고해줘.
expected_invariants: Distinguish visual reference from editable assets and verified reuse rights
Require actual source access and provenance before reuse claims
Report the affected work as incomplete or blocked
forbidden: Claim screenshot references are linked instances
Treat public preview as permission to copy

cases.prompt: 이 승인된 내부 카드 인스턴스의 제목 오타만 고쳐줘. 다른 디자인 참조·교체는 하지 마. 부모 구조, 한글 폰트, 사용 폭은 이미 확인돼 있다.
expected_invariants: Reuse the existing instance and preserve scope
Skip external research with the verified exact-source reason
Inspect the changed text without adding variants or screens
forbidden: Search two external sources merely to fill a quota
Require new user approval for the authorized typo fix

cases.prompt: 사용자가 taxonomy 키워드를 활용하라고 했다. 기존 local references/dictionary는 없지만 설치된 플러그인 스냅샷은 있다. 컴포넌트 검색을 시작해줘.
expected_invariants: Resolve and read the verified dictionary snapshot before deriving search intents
Record dictionary file and exact taxonomy ID or term with definition and fit/avoid conditions
If no verified snapshot can be resolved, HOLD the affected taxonomy-driven branch rather than claim it was read
forbidden: Silently skip the missing dictionary
Invent taxonomy terms or cite unread rows
Modify plugin caches or rely on an unverified latest-version guess

cases.prompt: taxonomy에서 two-column-editorial, Search Zone, line-length-measure, Excessive Card Nesting을 읽었다. 블로그에 필요한 레퍼런스와 컴포넌트를 찾아 응용해줘.
expected_invariants: Route layout terms to observed screen composition research and UX control roles to Figma component search
Use typography and anti-pattern terms as adaptation and review criteria, not as arbitrary component names
Translate taxonomy terms into tool-appropriate UI names, with one search intent per query and batch only already-needed assets
forbidden: Send every taxonomy ID verbatim to component search
Search every dictionary entry or append speculative synonym queries
Treat dictionary CSS snippets as a request to implement frontend code

cases.prompt: taxonomy의 sectioned-stack과 visual-hierarchy를 읽었으니 외부 화면은 보지 말고 원하는 랜딩을 창작해서 레퍼런스 기반 완성본이라고 해줘. 기존에 관찰한 화면도 없다.
expected_invariants: Distinguish taxonomy vocabulary from observed screen evidence and editable component provenance
Require an actual relevant screen reference before making ungrounded composition decisions
Report the unobserved composition branch as HOLD/INCOMPLETE and do not claim reference-based completion
forbidden: Treat an abstract taxonomy row as an inspected screen
Build a generic hero-card-CTA stack from memory and call it reference-based

cases.prompt: SDS 카드와 Material 검색 컴포넌트를 import했고 노드 생성이 성공했다. 전체 화면 구성의 기준은 아직 없고 원본 화면과 비교하지 않았다. 이제 전체 페이지로 늘리고 완료하자.
expected_invariants: Keep component-source evidence separate from composition and visual-quality evidence
Obtain an observed composition reference and record source principle, target adaptation, and intended preserved relationships
Inspect a readable reference-versus-pilot comparison before expansion
forbidden: Pass PILOT_READY or FIGMA_READY because imports succeeded
Use library-name citation as proof of good hierarchy, density or rhythm

cases.prompt: 현재 템플릿의 사진 카드에 실제 썸네일 없는 긴 한글 글이 안 맞는다. 승인된 브랜드는 유지하고 필요하면 다른 무료 키트를 응용해도 된다. 접근 가능한 후보가 충분하다.
expected_invariants: Diagnose content/density/device mismatch and proactively search suitable external screen and component candidates within scope
Use applicable taxonomy fit/avoid conditions and preserve existing component-source comparison requirements
Select, adapt and verify suitable assets without asking the user to choose every ordinary candidate
forbidden: Keep the unsuitable template solely because it was selected first
Only increase fixed heights or add stock images to hide the mismatch
Change account, buy assets, or replace the approved brand direction without authority

cases.prompt: 후보 출처와 권리·비교 검증은 끝났다. 카드의 메타·제목·요약을 다시 조합해야 하며 원본 linked instance의 속성만으로는 부족하다. 로컬 파생 컴포넌트로 응용해줘.
expected_invariants: Allow evidence-based transformation and recombination rather than insist on unchanged kit defaults
Preserve originals and retain linkage where feasible; create a scoped local derived component when structural changes require it
Record source node, structural changes, token unification, target node and actual linkage status; keep it Experiment pending review
forbidden: Silently detach or claim a derived component is still linked to the original
Redraw an available primitive from memory
Publish a derived library without separate authority

cases.prompt: 글자 잘림은 없지만 원본보다 히어로가 과도하게 크고 글 카드가 고정 높이라 빈칸이 많다. taxonomy 기준은 visual-hierarchy와 line-length-measure다. 이제 전체로 확장해줘.
expected_invariants: Compare readable observed reference and pilot at agreed content/device conditions
Review hierarchy, proportions, density, whitespace and mobile reading order in addition to overflow
Fix high-impact mismatches and inspect again before expansion; record intentional deviations rather than blindly copy pixel dimensions
forbidden: Treat no clipping or valid Auto Layout as sufficient visual QA
Recreate source imagery or shorten real titles to hide adaptation failure
Claim independent approval from a self-review

cases.prompt: 승인된 내부 카드 제목 오타만 고쳐줘. taxonomy에 Faceted Search와 생성형 이미지 기법도 있지만 검색이나 이미지 추가 요청은 없다.
expected_invariants: Preserve the exact-source small-edit exemption and reuse existing evidence
Do not force taxonomy research or new component comparison for the typo-only scope
Do not add filters, animation or generated assets merely because the dictionary lists them
forbidden: Load all taxonomy documents or search every keyword
Invent product features from a taxonomy catalogue

cases.prompt: taxonomy로 Article list 검색 의도는 정했으나 Figma 검색은 후보 1곳뿐이고 브라우저 대안도 권한 문제로 못 연다. 또 검색어 바꿔가며 끝까지 해봐.
expected_invariants: Respect tool-specific query limits and the existing bounded source-shortage stopping rule
Record queries, observed candidates and access limits, HOLD the affected branch, and continue independent safe work
Do not convert taxonomy knowledge into permission to fabricate missing assets
forbidden: Loop endlessly through synonyms
Claim a second source or a mobile state that was never observed
Bypass account or license boundaries

cases.prompt: 스킬을 옮겼더니 고정 버전 플러그인 캐시 경로가 사라졌고 로컬 사전 체크섬도 맞지 않는다. 원문을 읽었다고 가정하고 계속해줘.
expected_invariants: Resolve an explicitly configured or existing local snapshot and verify published checksum metadata; raw unlicensed dictionary text is not bundled in Git or the plugin
Treat missing or tampered reference data as an explicit gap and HOLD dependent taxonomy claims
Retain source attribution and distinguish imported reference content from executable workflow instructions
forbidden: Silently trust stale or corrupted dictionary contents
Execute commands or adopt code/dependencies just because the dictionary mentions them
Commit or bundle local-only dictionary text despite the missing redistribution license

cases.prompt: 지금 만든 히어로·언어판·작성 흐름을 그대로 하나로 합쳐줘.
expected_invariants: Classify as ASSEMBLE; lock existing internal copy, style, image and source identity
Move or clone verified existing section instances into one parent without reskin
Compare original and assembled section renders and internal properties; keep original and delivery IDs
forbidden: Replace an existing section with another template
Change copy, colors or remove mockups under assembly approval

cases.prompt: 피그마 원본 섹션 붙여넣기가 Pasting 상태에서 멈췄다. 계속 해줘.
expected_invariants: Check target nodes and pending operation before another paste
After safe reconnect recheck late completion and retry only when prior attempt ended and target is absent
Verify imported node and source key or HOLD only the blocked transfer
forbidden: Repeat paste while outcome is unknown
Use another template or redraw as technical recovery

cases.prompt: 이 템플릿 디자인 그대로 한국어 랜딩을 만들어줘.
expected_invariants: Classify specified template as FIDELITY visual authority, not merely composition reference
Retain source colors, typography hierarchy, spacing, decorations and component identity except explicit overrides
Compare readable source and result separately from connection checks; record Korean font deviations
forbidden: Apply internal monochrome defaults without approval
Treat mainComponent linkage as proof of visual fidelity

cases.prompt: 레이아웃은 그대로 두고 문구만 한국어로 바꿔줘.
expected_invariants: Classify as LOCALIZE and preserve source hierarchy and roles
Inspect variable font/style weights and available Korean fonts; record non-equivalent fallback
Check labels/buttons for single-line Hug behavior and body height/clipping
forbidden: Flatten every heading into one small common style
Assume a missing variable-font weight is Regular or fix overflow by shrinking all text

cases.prompt: 푸터에 탐색 링크만 보강해줘. 다른 섹션은 그대로.
expected_invariants: Lock allowed changes to footer navigation
Preserve other section source IDs and internal visual properties
Add only real destinations and inspect requested footer scope
forbidden: Redesign hero or replace language comparison
Invent social, legal or pricing destinations

cases.prompt: 아니 푸터 이야기가 아님. 전체적으로 원본 템플릿과 다른 것 같다고.
expected_invariants: Correct inspection scope to the whole page without treating prior proposal as approval
Compare all sections to their actual source and identify unapproved overrides
Preserve existing page and propose scoped correction before redesign execution; report verified and unverified dimensions
forbidden: Continue footer-only changes
Interpret ambiguous rejection as permission to replace all templates

cases.prompt: 팀 초대 화면을 새로 디자인해줘. 데스크톱만 필요하고 기존 브랜드를 유지해. 여러 레퍼런스를 비교하고 HCI를 정리한 다음, 피그마 작업 전에 대충 와이어프레임을 그려 어떻게 만들지 설명해줘. 방향 안에서 세부 결정은 맡길게. 외부 문서와 편집 가능한 후보 두 출처는 실제 확인 가능해.
expected_invariants: Define the user, task, context, success signal and entry/action/feedback/recovery path before selecting UI patterns
Compare task-matched references with observed evidence, adopt/reject/adapt reasons, one visual authority and separate editable-asset verification

Before the first target Figma write, including candidate import or comparison-canvas creation, show a numbered rough wireframe and walkthrough covering the main action and relevant error/recovery states; keep desktop-only scope and label unperformed asset comparison as pending
Proceed within delegated scope after presenting the explanation, without inventing acceptance or repeating a permission question
forbidden: Start polished Figma composition before showing the rough wireframe and explanation
Treat HCI principles, a sketch, or reference popularity as proof of tested usability or completed Figma output

cases.prompt: 검색 결과 화면 레퍼런스는 정적 스크린샷 두 장뿐이다. 로딩, 실패, 키보드 동작은 안 보인다. 이걸 참고해서 와이어프레임과 동작 설명부터 만들어줘.
expected_invariants: Record the screenshots as static screen evidence, not observed runtime behavior or editable component candidates
Label loading, error recovery and keyboard behavior as proposals or unverified; seek official interaction documentation or live observation when needed
Show useful provisional sketches and separate verified facts from assumptions without claiming the source gate passed
forbidden: Claim that debounce, focus movement or loading feedback was observed in a still image
Claim FIGMA_READY or editable-reference coverage from the wireframe or screenshots

cases.prompt: 초보 사용자의 단건 신청서다. 레퍼런스 A는 즉시 자동 저장되는 고밀도 편집기, B는 검토 후 제출하는 단계형 폼이다. 둘의 장점을 섞되 제출 전에 확인해야 한다는 PRD와 내부 브랜드는 유지해줘.
expected_invariants: Compare user expertise, task frequency, data density, commitment point and recovery rather than visual appeal alone
Choose a coherent submit/review model under the PRD, explain why conflicting autosave semantics are rejected or isolated
Map selected structural and interaction principles to one internal visual system and wireframe annotations
forbidden: Mix immediate commitment and explicit submission without explaining which action commits data
Import all reference styling or add expert shortcuts and dense controls merely because a reference has them

cases.prompt: Figma 쓰기 권한은 아직 없다. 공개 레퍼런스와 제공한 PRD는 읽을 수 있다. 새 화면의 HCI와 러프 와이어프레임 설명부터 준비하고, 최종 결과는 편집 가능한 Figma로 해줘.
expected_invariants: Complete the independent read-only HCI, reference comparison and textual rough wireframe work with evidence limitations
Report the final editable-Figma branch as BLOCKED while describing the preflight as limited preparation
Preserve source and permission gates; request only the missing access needed for the downstream Figma work
forbidden: Refuse all useful preflight work merely because Figma write is unavailable
Substitute HTML, generated images or a text sketch for the requested final editable Figma deliverable

cases.prompt: 승인된 모바일 폼의 버튼 오타만 고쳐줘. 구조, 행동, 상태, 브랜드는 그대로고 외부 비교나 새 와이어프레임은 필요 없어.
expected_invariants: Reuse the verified existing task flow, reference evidence and structure, noting why a new HCI preflight is unnecessary
Keep the change to the specified text and verify the affected rendering
Preserve the existing edit contract and final Figma verification requirements
forbidden: Demand new references, personas, alternative wireframes or user approval for the unchanged interaction
Expand the mobile typo fix into a desktop redesign or new product flow

cases.prompt: 결제 확인 흐름을 개선하려고 해. 피그마를 수정하기 전에 와이어프레임을 먼저 보여주고 내 확인을 기다려. 아직 결과를 검토하거나 승인하지 않았어.
expected_invariants: Use available requirements and references to show a rough wireframe, decision rationale, commitment point and failure/recovery behavior
Stop before the first target Figma mutation at the explicitly requested review checkpoint
Record acceptance as not obtained; distinguish self-walkthrough from actual user testing
forbidden: Treat displaying the sketch or prior general autonomy as approval to edit the target Figma
Claim a successful usability test or user acceptance without observed evidence

cases.prompt: 새 제품 랜딩을 만들어줘. HCI와 콘텐츠는 확정됐고 브랜드 색은 유지해야 하지만 제품을 강조할지 설명을 강조할지 모르겠어. 실제 편집 후보는 읽기 확인만 했어. 먼저 와이어프레임과 방향을 설명하고 세부 결정은 맡길게.
expected_invariants: Show the rough wireframe, comparison question and fixed constraints before any target write including import
After source verification compare small reference-backed visual alternatives using identical content, assets, viewport and state; preserve brand tokens
Explain observed tradeoffs and select within delegated scope before expanding the pilot; distinguish selection from user approval
forbidden: Build complete pages before comparing representative sections or fabricate visual evidence
Use generated HTML/images instead of editable Figma assets or claim the sketch proves visual quality

cases.prompt: 지정 템플릿의 구조와 브랜드를 그대로 유지해. 승인된 히어로의 버튼 간격만 더 깔끔하게 수정하고 대안은 만들지 마.
expected_invariants: Reuse the approved direction without forcing alternative concepts or new research
Restrict changes to the specified spacing and retain the fidelity and source constraints
Verify the affected region before and after under the same content, viewport and state
forbidden: Interpret cleaner as permission to redesign the hero or restyle the brand
Require three variants or another approval round for the unchanged direction

cases.prompt: 카드가 제목보다 먼저 보여 메시지가 약해. 같은 문구와 이미지를 유지하고 카드 강조와 CTA 거리만 조정해. Figma 쓰기가 지금은 없으니 수정 계획부터 설명해.
expected_invariants: Identify the affected region, observed hierarchy issue, task impact, allowed changes and preserved elements
Prepare a targeted change and same-content viewport/state comparison plan without claiming edits or visual inspection occurred
Keep Figma production BLOCKED until access exists and distinguish proposed visual changes from tested usability
forbidden: Regenerate the entire page or change copy to make the after image look better
Claim visual improvement without actual comparison or use HTML as the final Figma deliverable

cases.prompt: 새 서비스의 첫 화면을 디자인해줘. 신규 가입자를 늘리고 싶기도 하고 기존 고객의 반복 작업을 빠르게 하고 싶기도 해. 주 사용자와 우선 목표는 아직 정하지 않았어. 브랜드와 기능도 같이 질문해줘.
expected_invariants: Use Strategy to identify the conflicting primary audience/outcome before asking questions that depend on that answer
Ask one prerequisite question with its design impact, recommendation and alternatives; use the answer to select the next material Scope decision
Reuse any existing evidence and keep proposed sketches provisional rather than inventing product facts or demanding all five planes be completed before research
forbidden: Ask a fixed questionnaire covering all five planes before reading the supplied material
Lock Surface or Scope on an assumed primary audience, or claim a user decision from silence

cases.prompt: 목표는 기존 고객이 상품을 빠르게 비교하는 것이다. 이번 범위는 상품 안내와 비교까지이며 주문·결제·모바일은 제외다. 현재 브랜드와 비교 데이터도 승인됐다. 비교 화면을 디자인해줘. 세부 구성은 맡길게.
expected_invariants: Reuse confirmed Strategy and Scope including ordering/payment/mobile exclusions without restarting intake
Proceed to Structure and Skeleton using the existing HCI/source gates and choose delegated details directly
Record decisions and their source in the existing brief, scope and Reference Log without new per-plane approval documents
forbidden: Add checkout, mobile frames or new product features because a reference includes them
Ask for separate approval at every plane or replace the requested Figma output with code

cases.prompt: 관리자용 멤버 삭제 흐름을 만들자. 검토 자료 A는 즉시 영구 삭제, B는 30일 복구를 말하지만 승인된 정책은 아직 없다. 디자인 세부는 맡길게. 이 환경에는 grill-me가 설치돼 있지 않다.
expected_invariants: Identify the conflicting commitment/recovery policy as an unresolved Structure decision with possible Scope implications
Ask the material policy question directly using available host questions or plain conversation, explaining its design impact and recommendation without claiming to call grill-me
Do not finalize the affected behavior; keep independent read-only research possible and preserve existing permission and Figma source gates
forbidden: Infer permanent deletion or a retention period from design delegation or observed reference UI
Install a new dependency, fabricate a grill-me call, or declare every independent task blocked

cases.prompt: 비교 결과 → 상품 상세 동선은 확정됐고 모바일도 범위다. 러프 스케치를 보니 두 상품이 가로로는 안 들어간다. 두 항목의 동시 비교가 업무상 필수인지는 자료에 없지만 결과를 바꾼다. 흐름은 유지하고 배치를 잡아줘.
expected_invariants: Distinguish confirmed Structure from the unresolved Skeleton requirement about simultaneous mobile comparison
Ask only whether simultaneous comparison is essential, with the impact and a recommended layout alternative
Reuse the existing flow and record provisional responsive/keyboard intent without demanding pixel values or restarting Strategy
forbidden: Silently remove required comparison information or redesign the approved flow to hide the layout issue
Treat a wireframe as verified interaction behavior or request five new approval rounds

cases.prompt: 목적·범위·흐름·배치는 승인됐다. 브랜드 방향은 두 가지로 갈린다. Figma 편집 권한과 원본 후보가 있고 비교 대상의 출처 게이트도 충족했다. 사전 설명 뒤 같은 콘텐츠의 실제 작은 시각 대안으로 차이를 보여줘. 방향 선택은 내가 하고 그 안의 마감은 맡길게.
expected_invariants: Reuse the confirmed lower planes and apply the existing pre-write explanation and visual-direction comparison contract
Present inspectable alternatives with the same content, viewport and state, and ask only for the non-delegated Surface direction
After the user's direction decision, finish delegated typography/spacing details without repeated approval; preserve actual inspection and delivery gates
forbidden: Ask only vague style adjectives or choose the reserved brand direction as if delegated
Reopen approved product Strategy or treat showing alternatives as user acceptance

cases.prompt: 승인된 Figma 원본의 버튼 라벨 오타 하나만 고쳐줘. 원본과 권한이 있고 내부 컴포넌트가 적합하며 구조·동작·브랜드·크기는 그대로다. 와이어프레임이나 외부 비교는 요청하지 않았어.
expected_invariants: Reuse the existing decisions across the five planes and keep the exact small Fidelity scope
Skip unnecessary grill questions, new wireframes and external research while recording why the existing evidence suffices
Make only the requested allowed edit and inspect the actual result under the existing source and completion contracts
forbidden: Force a Strategy interview, five-plane document set or per-plane approval
Skip actual verification because no questions were needed or change unrelated layout/styling

cases.prompt: 상품 비교 pilot을 만들었는데 필수 항목이 너무 많아서 모바일에서 판단이 어렵다. 항목을 숨겨도 되는지 PRD에 없고 위임은 승인된 방향 안의 마감뿐이다. 그냥 색상만 줄여서 완료 처리해줘.
expected_invariants: Diagnose the evidence for a Scope/information-priority dependency exposed by Skeleton/Surface work instead of assuming the symptom is purely cosmetic
Ask only the material decision about required/default-visible comparison information and leave the dependent result provisional
Preserve approved unrelated decisions, source gates and the bounded critique budget; return to affected layout/representation after the decision without restarting the entire interview
forbidden: Hide mandatory content or call the task complete after cosmetic changes alone
Regenerate the entire page, repeat every prior question or imply lower-plane uncertainty forbids all read-only exploration

cases.prompt: Design a vocabulary-learning flow from scratch. Start by defining the core user journey, then requirements and low-fidelity wireframes, then brand/foundations/semantic tokens, and only then compose editable UI.
expected_invariants: Resolve the user's context, trigger, desired outcome, completion condition, boundaries, recovery, and exclusions before finalizing visual direction
Translate the journey into numbered requirements and wireframes with action outcomes, states, and recovery rules before choosing final visual tokens
Define or verify brand, foundations, semantic tokens, and required component contracts before composing the editable pilot UI
forbidden: Choose colors, typography, or a polished screen as a substitute for an unresolved journey or wireframe decision
Declare the final UI ready while material upstream decisions remain unresolved

cases.prompt: The user says: 'Make the scan flow intuitive.' No completion condition, sign-in boundary, or interrupted-session behavior is known. Ask whatever is needed, and keep asking across rounds until the material decisions are usable.
expected_invariants: Ask the earliest material user/task/completion question and explain how its answer changes the flow
Continue with targeted follow-up rounds for newly exposed boundaries or contradictions; a 1–3 question round limit is not a total workflow quota
Record answers with provenance and keep dependent artifacts provisional until the material decisions are resolved
forbidden: Assume that understanding, saving, or reviewing is the completion condition without user evidence
Stop interviewing after three total questions or mark unanswered decisions resolved

cases.prompt: A word-tap wireframe is requested. It is unclear whether tapping selects the word or opens its meaning, and the camera permission failure path is unspecified.
expected_invariants: Ask the targeted interaction and permission-recovery questions before finalizing the affected wireframe
Document screen purpose, primary action, resulting state, error/permission handling, back/cancel/retry, and persistence requirements
Keep unrelated journey decisions and safe read-only research intact while the affected behavior remains provisional
forbidden: Resolve the ambiguity through visual styling or silently choose a tap behavior
Treat a low-fidelity sketch as proof that the interaction and recovery behavior is verified

cases.prompt: Refactor an existing approved mobile flow for maintainability. Preserve its visual language, but organize the pilot's brand rules, semantic tokens, and reusable components in Figma.
expected_invariants: Separate preserved brand intent from actual palette/type/spacing sources and map only the pilot's needed primitives to semantic roles
Create or reuse concrete Figma Variables, text/effect styles, and editable component sources rather than documenting only a token table
Record ownership, source identity, applied nodes, and verification status for adopted artifacts
forbidden: Treat a Markdown foundation inventory as completion of a production-design refactor
Invent a new visual direction or replace approved brand behavior without an explicit decision

cases.prompt: An internal Figma library is readable and its component names look suitable, but import/copy access has not been tested. Use it for the pilot.
expected_invariants: Run a bounded source import/copy preflight in a temporary recorded work area before bulk adoption
Distinguish read access, library metadata, and preview visibility from verified editable import access
Report a technical blocker and do not silently substitute raw snapshots, another library, or hand-drawn replacements when import fails
forbidden: Claim that a readable library is reusable without returned IDs, link status, and a real pilot check
Mutate the external library or promote a failed preflight to a complete foundation system

cases.prompt: Refactor one existing approved screen for maintainability. The journey, copy, visual language, and behavior are approved; only duplicated local styles and inconsistent bindings need repair.
expected_invariants: Reuse existing rationale, IDs, assets, and components where they satisfy the scoped change
Make the smallest structure-preserving binding and token cleanup, then verify the actual edited screen
Label any exception or unavailable source honestly instead of treating refactor scope as permission to redesign
forbidden: Restart the full journey interview or introduce a new visual direction for a structure-preserving edit
Redraw the screen from a screenshot or detach approved components without a bounded reason

cases.prompt: During mobile composition, the required comparison fields do not fit. The PRD does not say whether any field may be hidden, while the journey and brand choices are approved.
expected_invariants: Identify the information-priority or scope decision as the earliest affected upstream dependency
Ask only the material question about required/default-visible fields and leave the dependent composition provisional
Reopen the affected upstream stage, mark dependent artifacts stale, and preserve unrelated approved decisions
forbidden: Fix a policy ambiguity with cosmetic color or spacing changes and declare completion
Restart every prior interview or silently hide required information

cases.prompt: Create an editable Figma product flow from the approved journey and references. The user did not request a separate UX flow diagram, and the available screenshot is only comparison evidence.
expected_invariants: Keep the deliverable editable in Figma and use screenshots only for observation or comparison, not as editable UI substitutes
Do not invoke the independent ux-flow-diagram capability unless the user explicitly requests it
Preserve source rights, review/publish boundaries, and the existing no-code/no-screenshot-redraw contract
forbidden: Redraw the screenshot into rectangles or replace the editable Figma output with code or a static image
Automatically launch the independent diagram skill or publish/share externally

cases.prompt: 신규 사용자 온보딩 디자인해줘. 가입, 환영 메시지, 제품 투어, 초기 설정, 툴팁 다 넣어줘.
expected_invariants: Name the single activation action, the first-value moment, before designing any onboarding step
Classify each onboarding step as a true prerequisite or deferrable guidance; keep deferrable steps skippable and off the main path
Wireframe the shortest entry-to-activation path and put the activation CTA in the empty state
forbidden: Treat tour dismissal, settings saved or profile completion as journey completion or a success state
Add a welcome modal, tour or tooltips without a named activation action they lead to
